// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
A uid string to identify the entity
User* (xref:#entidad-user[User])::
The user who owns these recovery codes.
Code hash* (string)::
Slow hash (argon2id) of the raw recovery code: short codes need a slow hash. The raw code is never stored.
Used at (datetime)::
Timestamp when this code was consumed via the MFA recovery step.          Null means the code is still valid and unused.
Created at* (datetime)::
Timestamp when this recovery code was generated.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de user mfa recovery code para controlar bloqueos optimistas
